report: Forearm research package v1: import report
rules: Nothing is imported. The design reconciles the package into the app's catalog (§0.1); forearm_mappings_v2 is written by hand by lane V1 against this report (§1.7). This report is the staging step the package asks for (§1.8 row 1).

Each cell's packageOwn holds the package's own values as received: its grade, index, band and tissue grade are the package's, labelled as such, and are imported nowhere a person or a calculator can read them (§2.3).
Nulls stay null: an unmodeled cell has no reading and is never a zero.
Muscles are read by code through one table checked against the 3D model's identity table; an unknown id is an error, never a name match.

reading is the cell in the app's vocabulary (§2.1) and the category categoryFor gives it on the variant it is read against; app is that variant's row in the forearm's current version (or the row §1.2 plans for a new catalog row).

contradicted: §1.1: All 50 non-alias records are draft_mapping (44) or blocked_protocol (6)
§1.1, §1.2: §1.1's 24 matched records are the records §1.2 calls existing, the alias left out
§1.5: Five package sources are already in the library (A01 = A36, S02 = S2, S06 = M1 and A4, S08 = S3, S12 = S1); the rest are not
§5.1: A carry gets no rep profile and keeps its whole-exercise prescription, as the package's §10 and §2.2 say

importCounts.basis: The package's §7.2 asks an idempotent import to report inserted, updated, skipped and blocked counts. Nothing is imported here: these are what the design has wave A's seed (catalog rows) and forearm_mappings_v2 (mapping rows) add or change, read from the design and the code, with nothing written anywhere but this report.

families.label: Keep ours
families.decision: FDS and FDP in wrist curls: package supporting dynamic, app incidental grip. Keep ours: no source measured FDS's or FDP's part in a wrist curl, and finger motion as the bar rolls is not credited (05-mappings.md). v2 carries the v1 row unchanged; the new wrist-curl rows (417, 418) follow the same family (§1.2).

families.label: Keep ours
families.decision: FDS and FDP in the towel pull-up: package incidental grip, app contributing isometric. Keep ours: the same category (incidental_isometric, the variant is not a deliberate hold), so no number differs; ours says why the towel makes the grip limit the set.

families.label: Review as incidental, if Hamrick is confirmed
families.decision: FPL in the towel hang, farmer hold, farmer's walk and suitcase carry: app draft contributing isometric. Review as incidental, isometric, basis inference, requiresNoStraps, action thumb IP flexion, sources S4 (FPL's action row) and Hamrick, Churchill, Schmitt and Hylander 1998 (pmid.9503091, abstract). Reviewed only if lane V1 confirms Hamrick's record with its locator; otherwise all five FPL rows stay draft, with no fallback to anatomy alone.

families.label: Keep ours
families.decision: The brachioradialis in a supinated, thick-grip curl: package direct, app contributing. Keep ours: M1 found its contribution differed only with the hand pronated; S07 found no forearm EMG difference with a thick grip in the concentration curl it tested.

families.label: Adopt: stabilizer, isometric
families.decision: The wrist extensors (ECRL, ECRB, ECU) steadying the wrist in the grip tasks (143, 144, 402, 403, and 419): adopt as stabilizer, isometric, action wrist extension, basis emg, citing M2 ("Wrist-extensor activity accompanied gripping"; limitation: names the wrist extensors as a group, not each muscle; a dynamometer, not a barbell), with S05 where its excerpt names the muscle; requiresNoStraps on the hangs. 12 rows, plus 3 on 419 counted with the new rows.

families.label: Adopt only if a source names them
families.v2: adds rows only if a source passes
families.decision: The wrist flexors (FCR, FCU) steadying in the grip tasks and the carries (143, 144, 145, 299, 402, 403, 409, 419): adopt only if S05's or M2's excerpt names FCR, FCU or the wrist flexors as a group among the muscles active in the grip. M2's recorded note says only "flexor activity", which does not pass as recorded; lane V1 reads both excerpts first. 0 to 16 rows.

families.label: Not adopted in v2
families.decision: Any wrist muscle steadying in curls, rows, pulldowns, deadlifts, levers and the pinch: not adopted in v2. M2 measured a hand gripping a dynamometer; v1 applied it to holds and carries, where the grip is the task, not to lifts where the grip is incidental. A later version may, with a source on gym grips.

families.label: Adopt as incidental
families.decision: FPL in deliberate full-hand holds (143, and 419): adopt as §1.3, incidental, isometric, basis inference, Hamrick 1998, bare hand only (requiresNoStraps); draft if Hamrick's record is not confirmed. 1 row, plus 1 on 419 counted with the new rows.

families.label: Not reviewed in v2
families.decision: FPL in every other gripped handle (curls, rows, deadlifts, shrugs; here also the wrist curls, the levers and the gripper): not reviewed in this version. Hamrick's finding makes these candidates for a later version, reviewed family by family with the same limitation.

families.decision: PL, EDM and EI as helpers in more exercises: not adopted; nothing new in the package.
